name: How do I choose the right size and style of pergola for my backyard?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size and style of pergola for my backyard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right pergola involves considering your outdoor space's size, your intended use, and your home's architectural style. For example, a dining area may require a larger pergola than a small seating nook. Measure your available space and consider the desired level of shade. For style, aim for a design that complements your home’s existing aesthetic, whether modern, traditional, or rustic. Our design team can provide recommendations based on your property layout and preferences.
